messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick FYI - oversized crate labeled for "Sam Ortiz" left in lobby at 9:45. No visitor badge yet.
Front Desk: Courier flagged it as 'fragile' and asked us to hold. It's by the north planter.
Sam: That's mine! I'm running late but will swing by ~11:30. Please don't send back.
Riley: If it's fragile, can we put it in the storage closet instead of mail room? Mail room is packed.
Front Desk: Storage closet (room 102) is locked after 10am. We can move to bike garage if that's ok.
Maya (People Ops): Plan: hold at desk until 11:15, then transfer to Garage spot G2. We need two people to move it.
CourierBot: Tracking 992234 - held at reception. Reattempt window 72h.
Sam: Garage is fine. I'll bring ID. Thanks!
Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll update the log and tag the package: "#2719 - Sam Ortiz - fragile - held".
Front Desk: Noted and logged.
